Our products

Baking Supplies by Category

Skypex supplies cream, fillings, bread ingredients and packaging in wholesale bulk. Pick a category for a quick answer, a video and the page for that brand.

Which whipping and cooking cream does Skypex supply?

Skypex supplies Pristine whipping and cooking cream, plus Dr.baker creams, to bakeries, cafés and hotels across Kenya.

Pristine is our hero cream, used for decorating cakes, filling pastries and finishing desserts. Ask for the pack that fits your menu.

Pristine →

Which fruit fillings, compounds and finishing products does Skypex supply?

Skypex supplies Frutti and Dawn fruit fillings, Dawn flavour compounds, Skybake mirror glaze and Skypower sprinkles.

Fillings for tarts, cheesecakes and cakes, with glaze and sprinkles to finish. Frutti comes in mango, blueberry, strawberry and raspberry.

Which bread mixes, improvers and yeast does Skypex supply?

Skypex supplies Komplet bread mixes, Skypower bread improvers and instant yeast from Victoria and Bruggeman.

Better bread texture starts with the right mix and improver. We supply them in bulk for bakeries that bake every day.

Questions

Wholesale baking supplies in Nairobi: your questions

Does Skypex sell wholesale or retail baking supplies?

Skypex Supplies supplies wholesale bulk baking ingredients and packaging. Retail packs of our brands are available at supermarkets. [CONFIRM: minimum order quantities]

Where can a home baker in Kenya buy Skypex brands?

Look for retail packs at your favourite supermarket. If a pack is hard to find, message us on WhatsApp and we will help.

Where is the Skypex shop and when is it open?

G16, Spectrum Business Park, Baba Dogo Road, Nairobi. Monday to Friday 8:00 to 5:00, Saturday 8:00 to 1:00. Closed Sundays and public holidays.

How do I get wholesale prices?

Send a WhatsApp message to +254 722 386 394 or use the order builder above. Prices depend on stock and quantity, so we confirm them with each order.

Which products does Skypex supply to bakeries?

Cake mixes, sugar paste, whipping and cooking cream, fruit fillings, mirror glaze, sprinkles, cocoa and chocolate, sauces and spreads, bread mixes, instant yeast and baking packaging.
